notes: Fixed News and Markets not loading (they now go through our own server instead of a flaky public relay — needs the latest server.js deployed too). Refreshed the colour palette, and the bottom tabs are now icons. You can add a profile picture from Settings, shown at the top of the app. Added full text versions of Pulippani Jothidam 300 and Sothidam Munnuru (previously only Agastiyar Arudam had one) so all three classical references are on-device. Jadhagam and Astro readings now give a full Jothida Palan grounded in real excerpts from these texts — field of study for kids, business vs. job for adults, marriage age and children, health to watch for later in life, favourable/difficult life periods, and Parikaram (temples/remedies) for hard times.
